contradicted._note: Must stay above block_threshold (0.50). DeBERTa contradiction is very reliable at raw>0.6

partially_supported._note: Noisy middle class — broad spread, sits between flag and block thresholds

unverifiable._note: Always below flag_threshold (0.55) — neutral class should never trigger FLAG/BLOCK

_meta.note: Bootstrap parameters from DeBERTa-v3 paper. Run scripts/calibrate_nli.py to replace with empirical values.
